subject: Possible reaction - Neurolept-X
body_text:
Reporting a possible adverse reaction.

Patient is a 46-year-old male taking Neurolept-X. He describes tremor and difficulty sleeping. I cannot establish exactly when the symptoms began relative to starting the medication, and he is also taking two other products I have not been able to confirm.

Reporting for completeness.

Dr Kwame Mensah, Accra, Ghana
